# Wanhe Compliance — original data

> Chinese advertising-law & AI-labeling compliance checks. Technical verification, not legal advice.

## Benchmark (2026)
- 52 cases, 0 false negatives, 0 false positives, 80 rule groups (63 zh + 17 en), ~12ms/check
- https://wh-bi.github.io/wanhe-compliance/
- https://wh-bi.github.io/wanhe-compliance/medical-beauty-2026.html
- https://wh-bi.github.io/wanhe-compliance/negative-cases-2026.html

## SDK
- https://github.com/Wh-bi/wanhe-compliance

## Contact
- Free email self-check: hello@wanhetools.top (text only; free, no delivery promise)
- Public site pending ICP filing; offline package: https://github.com/Wh-bi/wanhe-compliance/releases

## API evidence
- GET /api/v1/rules: 80 rule groups with stable rule_id (R001-R080) and rules_version
- POST /api/v1/check: each issue includes rule_id; evidence includes content_sha256/generated_at
- Offline package 0.2.1: same rule_id/evidence fields, no network
